places.place_summary: Tyler Park Center for the Arts runs a single-chamber wood kiln (the Manabigama) and offers community wood firings where outside potters can participate by loading bisqued and glazed work, stoking shifts, and attending unloading. They also offer private rentals and fully mentored group workshops for guilds and groups.

firing_evidence.quote: The Tyler Park Arts Manabigama (Japanese for "beautiful learning kiln") is a single chamber wood kiln designed to be efficient, and give beautiful results. Kiln firings are scheduled periodically throughout the year.
